title: Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2015
short_title: Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2015

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would add regional Australia statements to Commonwealth fiscal reporting, providing information for assessing how major government policy decisions affect areas outside metropolitan centres.
The Treasurer would publish and table a statement with each Budget economic and fiscal outlook and each mid-year economic and fiscal outlook report.
The reporting framework would begin the day after Royal Assent and sit within the Charter of Budget Honesty alongside existing obligations for government fiscal reporting.
changes: Statements would address likely economic, social, cultural and environmental effects of key government initiatives on regional Australia.
The Treasurer could request supporting information from Commonwealth bodies.
Those bodies would have to supply requested information in time for it to inform preparation of the statements.
summary.affected: The Treasurer and Commonwealth bodies required to provide information for regional Australia statements are affected.

speeches.speaker: Cathy McGowan
speeches.brief: The member moved the Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2015, requiring the Treasurer to table Regional Australia Statements with each budget and Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook. The bill aims to ensure government policies assess their economic, social, cultural and environmental impacts on regional Australia, citing the 2014-15 budget's omission of such a statement and its disproportionate effects on areas like Wodonga, Wangaratta, Benalla and Alexandra.
